summary.headline: Adds a new GET /time endpoint that returns the current server time in ISO 8601 and Unix epoch formats.

changes.description: Added a new Express route handler for GET /time, placed between the existing /health and /echo endpoints.

addedLines: res.json({ iso: new Date().toISOString(), epoch: Date.now() });

endpoint.description: Returns the current server time in two formats for integration testing and time-synchronization verification.

epoch.description: Current time as Unix epoch milliseconds

impactAnalysis.apiSurface: Extended with one new read-only GET endpoint; existing endpoints unchanged.
impactAnalysis.configuration: No environment variables or config changes required.
impactAnalysis.documentation: README.md was not updated to list the new /time endpoint.
impactAnalysis.testing: No automated tests were added or modified.
impactAnalysis.performance: Negligible impact; endpoint performs a single Date instantiation per request.
impactAnalysis.security: Low risk; endpoint exposes only server time with no user input handling.

existingEndpoints.description: Echoes JSON body and request headers

recommendations.item: Update README.md to document the new GET /time endpoint alongside existing endpoints.
Consider adding a simple integration test for the /time endpoint response shape.
